description: This Java source file defines the RetrieveAttributesStrategy class, which handles the RetrieveAttributes command by extracting attributes from a Thing object, creating a response, and managing entity tags. It is part of the persistence strategies for 'things' in the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: RetrieveAttributesStrategy
classes.description: A strategy class that handles the RetrieveAttributes command, extracting attributes from a Thing and generating the corresponding response or error.

methods.name: doApply
methods.description: Executes the strategy to retrieve attributes from a Thing, returning a Result with the relevant event or error.

methods.name: extractAttributes
methods.description: Extracts Attributes from a given Thing, throwing if the entity is null.

methods.name: getAttributesJson
methods.description: Generates a JsonObject of the Attributes, optionally filtering by selected fields.

methods.name: previousEntityTag
methods.description: Returns the previous EntityTag for the given command and entity.

methods.name: nextEntityTag
methods.description: Computes the next EntityTag based on the new entity's attributes.
